claim_boundary: AQ26 ranks evidence and review priorities. It does not publish causal, medical, legal, permit-breach or source-apportionment determinations without specialist review.
comparison_boundary: Record volume and review-priority scores must not be interpreted as facility risk, emissions performance, health impact or non-compliance.

pollutant_watchlist.aq26_use: monitoring trend, episode and exposure-context screening only
pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: PM2.5 near a site does not identify a source without source apportionment, meteorology and comparator analysis.
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Fine particulate matter is a core public-health metric and can reflect combustion, secondary aerosol and regional background contributions.

pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Requires source, wind-sector and background comparison before assigning contribution.
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Coarse and fine particle mixture relevant to dust, combustion, construction, road and industrial sources.

pollutant_watchlist.aq26_use: candidate combustion/traffic context and monitor-role check
pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Road traffic and urban background must be separated before facility interpretation.
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Combustion and traffic-sensitive pollutant group, often highly affected by roads and urban geometry.

pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Ambient impact cannot be inferred from permit existence alone.
pollutant_watchlist.pollutant: SO2, HCl, HF and acid gases
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Relevant to industrial combustion and waste-incineration permit conditions.

pollutant_watchlist.aq26_use: periodic sample, permit, ash/residue and official-report evidence review
pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Metals require original laboratory/stack/residue data and chain-of-custody review.
pollutant_watchlist.pollutant: Metals including Hg, Cd, Pb, As, Cr, Ni
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Persistent toxic pollutants can be relevant to waste-stream and residue questions.

pollutant_watchlist.aq26_use: watchlist and evidence-gap flag only until specialist records exist
pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Do not infer presence, exposure or health effect without specific measurements and expert review.
pollutant_watchlist.pollutant: Dioxins, furans, PCBs, PAHs and PFAS-relevant waste streams
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Persistent organic pollutants and emerging contaminant pathways are central to long-term toxicology questions.

pollutant_watchlist.aq26_use: facility, sector and national inventory context
pollutant_watchlist.claim_boundary: Use lifecycle/system-boundary caution; do not compare options without consistent assumptions.
pollutant_watchlist.pollutant: CO2 and fossil carbon from waste
pollutant_watchlist.why_it_matters: Climate and circular-economy lock-in question, especially plastic-rich residual waste.

purpose: Public-safe scientific screening layer that combines evidence, official registers, planning context, open monitoring/weather context, national emissions resources and readiness gates. It is not a source-attribution or health-determination engine.
readiness_statement: Ready for evidence-screening, provenance review and data-gap challenge only; not ready for source attribution, permit-compliance conclusions, exposure modelling, health-effects assessment or comparative facility ranking.
